articles.title: XRPL could close its biggest DeFi gap if new AMM amendment passes
articles.snippet: A draft proposal filed Tuesday would extend the XRP Ledger's native automated market maker with three swappable curve types, giving liquidity providers more efficient ways to deploy capital and closing one of XRPL DeFi's longest-standing gaps.

articles.title: The Clarity Act won’t lead to adoption without crypto tax reform
articles.snippet: The legislation is being framed as a turning point for U.S. crypto policy, but there’s a major piece of the puzzle being overlooked, argues Singh.

articles.title: Bitmine made its largest ETH purchase this year despite Tom Lee's slowdown suggestion
articles.snippet: The company bought 111,942 ether last week worth $237 million, ramping up purchases to take advantage of ETH's drop below $2,200.

articles.title: Strive acquires 1,109 bitcoin, raising total holdings to 16,500 coins
articles.snippet: ASST climbs 133% in three months as Strive grows holdings to 16,500 BTC and explores fresh capital raising options.

articles.title: XRP Ledger to delete NFT junk and patch key bugs in a new upgrade
articles.snippet: The XRP Ledger is rolling out the fixCleanup3_1_3 upgrade on Wednesday, to clean up expired NFTs.
